title: Provider model retirements break saved agent configurations and scheduled tasks
summary: GPT-5.4/5.4-mini retire from Codex on 2026-08-31; saved configurations, custom agents, and scheduled tasks with pinned model IDs must be migrated. Confirms provider-side model lifecycle changes alone alter agent behavior and break automation.

evidence.summary: Model retirement forces migration of pinned model IDs in saved configs and scheduled tasks.
